gate_22_tree_against_brute_force.claim: the tree finds every crossing brute force finds: each mesh's crossings exactly, its signed chord within rounding on each crossing's scale, the nearest t within rounding and its triangle, on every judged ray of every draw

prediction.why: the same crossing decisions on rays whose barycentric margin is above the dtype's rounding; the watertight test claims each crossing once

gate_22_tree_against_brute_force.metric: crossings equal; chord error over 64 eps times the summed scale of the crossings

control.plant: dropped-leaf: the leaf of the triangle the judged rays cross most emptied; flipped-winding: that triangle's winding reversed (moves the chord by 2t on each ray through it)
control.resolution: one crossing on one ray: the plants are a whole crossing (or 2t on the chord), far above rounding

gate_22_tree_against_brute_force.if_wrong: a miss: a draw whose judged rays cross no planted triangle (the test asserts one does); a false alarm: the margin or the rounding scale is too tight for a grazing ray
gate_22_tree_against_brute_force.cannot_discriminate_if: no judged ray crosses a mesh (asserted against) or the margin leaves out most rays (test_the_judged_rays_are_most_of_the_draw holds over 90 % judged)

gate_23_mesh_swap.claim: a tube's and a sphere's drawings traced as meshes image as their closed forms do: within the sagitta's bracket on the same sub-rays at every pixel, and within the design's line (contrast times 1/(2S) + sqrt(2) s_px, plus the factor's spread over the pixel) against route 1; S = 4 is the default because past it the drawing's sagitta, not the sub-rays, sets a silhouette's error
gate_23_mesh_swap.case: tests/sensing/test_mesh_swap.py (the tube at S = 2, 4, 8 against the closed-form tube through two builds; the ellipsoid's drawing against the sphere's route 1, opaque and attenuating)

prediction.why: the drawing's vertices lie on the surface and it is convex, so each sub-ray's chord lies between the inscribed and the true surfaces' chords

gate_23_mesh_swap.metric: per pixel: outside the bracket (must be at most zero); |traced - route 1| over the design's line (must be at most one)
gate_23_mesh_swap.s_choice: predicted from the development runs: the opaque sphere's mean edge error at S = 4 within 1.1 of S = 8's, and its max within 1.6 of S = 8's; S = 4 kept

control.plant: shifted-mesh: the traced mesh moved half a pixel's footprint (0.67 um) across the line of sight
control.expected_rate: 10/10 on the tube's float32 S = 4 case and on the sphere's float64 opaque case
control.resolution: the bracket is at most 5e-3 wide on any pixel (test_the_brackets_are_narrow_enough_to_see_half_a_pixel), against a half pixel's hundredths at a silhouette

gate_23_mesh_swap.if_wrong: outside the bracket: the tree, the sub-rays or the drawing's placement; over the design's line only: route 1's own pixel integration or the line's derivation
gate_23_mesh_swap.cannot_discriminate_if: the meshes are out of view (the frames' transmission would be one everywhere): they fill the view by construction

gate_24_refusals.claim: a derivative in the detector's numbers with a mesh in view is refused by name in forward mode, reverse mode and a fit; a derivative through the poses passes against central differences and reverse equals forward; a moving mesh, a moving camera with a mesh, an open mesh named in absorbers are refused by name with their routes

prediction.why: the refusal is asked before compiling; the structure does not depend on the poses

gate_24_refusals.metric: the refusals' codes and routes; the pose derivative's error within test_in_loop_forward's tolerance

control.plant: no-mesh-refusal: the camera's refusal removed; the forward derivative in fy over the mesh's top wall is then zero against central differences that see the wall move
control.resolution: a derivative exactly zero against a nonzero central difference

gate_24_refusals.if_wrong: a passed control: the mesh's part carries a derivative after all (then the refusal could be narrowed)

controls.one_ulp: the tube's attenuation one ulp up on the head's side only (a constant of the maker): the text differs, 1/1 a dtype
controls.repeat: the head's text written twice is the same

second_round.written: 2026-11-14, committed before the second probe (cost and bits after the fix below); the first round's outcomes are written beside the first predictions
second_round.why: the first round's cost arm missed its frame prediction (a run's second 30 steps 1.9 to 3.1 times the no-mesh scene's against 0.85 to 1.15) and its bits arm reported a difference in every program. Profiled on the laptop, the miss was MADDENING comparing the bytes of the node's two mesh constructor ndarrays (7.9 MB) at each chunk of a run (244 tobytes calls, 0.25 s of 0.28 s, with no frame in the run); the bits difference is the file-name and line-number tables that open the compiled text (every other line of the text is equal base to head on the laptop). The fix: the arrays held as a registered pytree (Frozen); the comparison drops those tables.
second_round.operating_point: as the first round: 99 328-triangle tube-wall mesh, the ballistic scene at 320x240 and 640x480, float64 and float32, 4-vCPU runner; arms none, mesh, none-nf and mesh-nf (frame period 1000 ms: no frame in the 30 steps)

cost.claim: step compile mesh over none 0.9 to 1.15 (as the first round, which measured 1.08 to 1.10); the second run of 30 steps with 10 frames mesh over none 1.2 to 2.5 (laptop, float32 320x240: 1.8); with no frame in the run (the -nf arms) mesh's run at most 0.04 s absolute at 320x240 and 0.08 s at 640x480, and mesh over none 1.0 to 6 (the none run is a few milliseconds)
cost.basis: measured-before on the laptop after the fix (mesh 0.075 s, none 0.04 s with frames; mesh 0.013 s, none 0.006 s without), not a runner's
cost.if_wrong: over the band: another per-step read of the leaves, which the profile would show again (the first round's was in MADDENING's sync); the per-frame share (about 2.7 ms a frame on the laptop with 6 MB of leaves, 1 ms or less with 80 triangles) is not explained by the profile and is reported as measured

bits.claim: the compiled text, with the file-name, function-name and call-site tables dropped, is equal base to head for the graph's step, the forward run and its forward-mode derivative, float64 and float32, for the in-loop camera's ballistic scene with a Tube structure (no static mesh, no drawn static kind); the one-ulp control (the tube's attenuation one ulp up on the head's side) differs, 1/1 a dtype
bits.basis: measured-before (the laptop: step_f64 equal base 375ce8cd to head 370a9b5d once the tables are dropped, 1 650 612 bytes each)
